mcq.q: Only 2% of tickets are urgent. A model predicting "not urgent" for everything scores…
mcq.why: Accuracy rewards the majority class; recall on the rare class reveals the failure.

mcq.q: Which is leakage when predicting churn on day 3?
mcq.why: Month-total refunds include future information that is not available on day 3.

mcq.q: When is a PR curve more informative than ROC?
mcq.why: With rare positives, ROC can look good while precision is poor; PR curves expose that.
